Spring Framework remains pinned to 5.3.39 on this Java 17 line. These newly reported CVEs do not have an in-line remediation available within the currently supported Spring 5.3.x baseline for this project.

file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.
Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. Remediation for this CVE requires moving off the Jetty 10 line, which is outside the current Java 17 / Jetty 10 constraints.

Spring Framework 5.3.39 is the latest public 5.x release available in Maven Central. Patched 5.3.x releases referenced by the advisories require commercial support. These findings are accepted for this release because no publicly available minor/patch upgrade remediates them, and moving to Spring 6.x is outside the no-major-upgrade constraint.
activemq-client 5.19.6 is used by interlok-jmx-activemq. No newer 5.19.x release is available that resolves these CVEs. Review when a patched release becomes available.
proton-j 0.34.1 and proton-jms 0.12.2 are used by interlok-jmx-amqp via qpid-jms-client. No patched release of proton-j is available in the 0.34.x line; review when a newer release is published.

Commons Lang 2.6 is the latest 2.x release available in Maven Central. CVE-2025-48924 affects ClassUtils.getClass; remediation requires Commons Lang 3.18.0 or newer, a major upgrade with package/API changes. This finding is accepted under the no-major-upgrade constraint. Review when migrating the remaining Commons Lang 2.x usage.
